1. Receive karne wale phone par “Show QR code” dabayein.
2. Bhejne wale phone par “Scan QR code” dabakar code scan karein. Camera na ho to “Search phones” use karein.
3. Jitni chahein files chunein, ya Gallery ya Files se “WifiP2P se bhejein” ke saath share karein.
4. Dono phones paas (kuch meter) aur dono screens on rakhein. Android 10+ phones, dono support karein to, apne-aap tez 5 GHz band use karte hain.
5. Mili hui files Downloads/WifiP2P me save hoti hain. History se kholein.
